# BreatheWise — Urban Air Quality Assistant

> GenAI-powered Next.js assistant helping families, commuters, and community groups navigate severe winter smog and urban air pollution with source-cited WHO/EPA recommendations and quantified impacts.

## Routes

- [Live City AQI Lookup & Persona Selector](https://breathewise-urban-aqi.vercel.app/)
- [Profile Onboarding](https://breathewise-urban-aqi.vercel.app/onboarding)
- [Persona Dashboard & CADR/Commute Calculators](https://breathewise-urban-aqi.vercel.app/dashboard)
- [Grounded AI Air Quality Coach](https://breathewise-urban-aqi.vercel.app/chat)
- [Community Action & WhatsApp Share Planner](https://breathewise-urban-aqi.vercel.app/community)

## Standards & Discovery

- [Agentic Resource Directory](https://breathewise-urban-aqi.vercel.app/.well-known/ard.json)
- [XML Sitemap](https://breathewise-urban-aqi.vercel.app/sitemap.xml)
